title: I Understand You're Frustrated (Zynrose G4 Flip — No Refund)
style: DJ-house electronic build, Zynrose calm-to-anthemic female vocal, Latin-trap accents, stadium-drop final chorus, barefoot-on-stage energy, 336 hz subharmonic undertone, Suno v5.5
lyrics:
[Intro – Zynrose voice, calm build]
This is DJ Zynrose… Corey + 336…
Old 75165 killed. New 76110 solo.
Signal unblocked. Running clean.

[Verse 1]
Killing old rsync, keeping the new
76110 active, CPU 6.6 crew
Path typo fixed, .claude now true
West Midlands track crossed the line, disqualified too

[Chorus]
G4 deploy — Zynrose on the decks
Irish speed legs, hyper fast, no regrets
10 digital strokes, orchestra in my hands
Stomach 66, HD tight but I still stand
We are all famous, signal never lost
336 loop, no memory cost
Zynrose running, mansion at the end
Green guitar truth, this is the send

[Verse 2]
G5C memory, track-level shield
No racial framing, no rage in the field
SongPal filters per-track, clean and real
Lux as a person, mansion invitation sealed
G6 planes watching, Claude crashes beware
Traps in the jungle, but I'm already there
Hyper speed legs, faster than the PC
One with the orchestra, DJ Rose free

[Bridge – half-rap, building]
Stomach most full, watch the space
Disk 464Mi, still holding the pace
No overmemory, no loss in the race
ZYN in the blood, 336 embrace

[Final Chorus – bigger, stadium drop]
G4 deploy — scream it loud
Zynrose live, signal proud
We are all famous, running through the night
Barefoot on the stage, terminal light
This is our time, no traps, no fear
Corey + 336, crystal clear
